preamble.summary: 1 Samuel 3 narrates Samuel's call vision at Shiloh — the famous 'Speak, Lord, for your servant is listening' passage. 4QSamᵃ preserves the chapter with several minor agreements with LXX against MT, including the wording of Samuel's response and the Lord's threefold call.
preamble.notable_variants: Minor wording differences only, with 4QSamᵃ generally agreeing with LXX. No theologically significant variants.

variant_notes: The threefold divine call to Samuel tracks MT. The substance of the call vision is identical across all witnesses.
'All Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel was a confirmed prophet of the LORD' tracks MT — the establishment of Samuel's prophetic authority.
